detail: Common deadlines are 15 January for numerus fixus (capped-intake) programmes and 1 May for most other programmes. Individual programmes, especially for non-EU applicants who need a visa, often set much earlier deadlines, so check each programme page.

provenance.source: Study in NL - How to apply

detail: English-taught programmes require proof of English proficiency, commonly IELTS or TOEFL. Typical minimums are around IELTS 6.0-6.5 for bachelor's and 6.5-7.0 for master's, but each programme sets its own exact score. Verify on the programme page.

provenance.source: Study in NL - How to apply

detail: Some popular programmes limit the number of places (numerus fixus) and select among applicants. These have a fixed earlier deadline (15 January) and a selection procedure, so you cannot apply late.

provenance.source: Study in NL - How to apply

detail: The official Study in NL StudyFinder lists English-taught programmes across Dutch institutions. You search and apply directly; you do not need a paid agency to access it.

provenance.source: Study in NL - Find a study programme
